run_nn_distance: run nn_distance to compute nearest neighbor distances between two point cloud tensors
run_huber_loss: run huber_loss to compute a smooth L1 loss on a PyTorch error tensor
run_demo_nn_distance: run demo_nn_distance to print nearest neighbor distances for random point clouds
test_nn_distance_l1smooth: test nn_distance with l1smooth=True to compute Huber loss-based nearest neighbor distances
test_nn_distance_l1: test nn_distance with l1=True to compute L1-based nearest neighbor distances between point clouds
